momo:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production sprite pose sheet for a mobile monster selector.
Primary request: Produce ONE original character sprite sheet, landscape 2048x1024 pixels, EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows, eight equal 512x512 cells. Real transparent alpha background, with no fake checkerboard, no visible grid, no labels, no text, no ground, no ground shadows and no props.
Style: Simple bold flat 2D cartoon shapes, saturated colors, charming slightly silly monster, minimal shading, clean smooth silhouette. Flat graphic art suitable for a joyful children's music app. Not 3D, not realistic, no lighting effects.
Composition: EXACT 4x2 arrangement. SAME character in all eight frames; consistent anatomy, body scale, design, colors and proportions across every cell. Full body centered within each cell. Normally feet meet local y=450px baseline. Maintain at least 50px transparent margins within each cell; no limbs cross boundaries. Each pose fits entirely in its own cell. Do not enlarge any frame. All eight figures are the same size.
Eight poses in reading order, row-major:
0 top left: neutral smiling, eyes open, arms down.
1 top second: identical to pose 0 except eyes fully closed for blinking.
2 top third: leaning gently left with arms in a dancing pose.
3 top right: leaning gently right with the opposite dancing pose.
4 bottom left: waving one hand.
5 bottom second: both arms raised, smiling excitedly.
6 bottom third: feet tucked in during a small happy jump.
7 bottom right: laughing with crescent eyes and hands near cheeks.
No copyrighted characters or recognizable existing mascots.
Character name (never render name): Momo. Friendly round BLUE shaggy monster: electric cobalt shaggy hair around top and sides, sky-blue pear-shaped face/body, two large white oval eyes with dark indigo pupils, small mouth with two tiny white teeth, small sky-blue arms and feet, a tiny yellow tuft or spot on chest that is NOT a tie. Adorable bashful personality. Rounded, soft, funny and lovable.

momo-parts:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: character PARTS sheet for cut-out animation in a mobile app. The parts are assembled and animated in software, so every part must be drawn separately and completely.
Primary request: Produce ONE parts sheet, square 2048x2048 pixels, EXACTLY four equal columns and four equal rows, sixteen equal 512x512 cells. Real transparent alpha background, no fake checkerboard, no visible grid, no labels, no text, no ground, no shadows, no props. Each part is centered in its own cell with at least 40px transparent margin and never crosses a cell border. Empty cells stay fully transparent.
Style: Simple bold flat 2D cartoon shapes, saturated colors, minimal shading, clean smooth silhouette, exactly the same style, palette and proportions as the existing character. Not 3D, not realistic, no lighting effects.
Sixteen cells in reading order, row-major. Parts are drawn as if the character faces the viewer in a relaxed neutral pose. Scale: the body in cell 0 fills about 80% of its cell height; all other parts use the SAME scale as the body so they fit together.
0 top-left: BODY WITH HEAD ONLY, one piece: torso and head, WITHOUT arms, WITHOUT legs, WITHOUT eyes, WITHOUT mouth, WITHOUT eyebrows. Plain face area in skin color so eyes and mouth can be placed on top.
1: back hair or back fur silhouette that sits BEHIND the body (only the parts sticking out around the head), same outline as the character's hair.
2: front hair tuft that sits on top of the head, in front of the face.
3: chest marking or belly patch as a separate piece.
4: left EYE WHITE only, an oval white shape with the character's outline color, no pupil.
5: right eye white only, same.
6: MOUTH closed, small friendly smile.
7: mouth open, happy, with the character's teeth.
8: mouth laughing wide.
9: mouth round O shape, as when eating or surprised.
10: LEFT ARM with hand, one piece, drawn straight and slightly relaxed, pointing DOWN, shoulder end at the top of the cell; the shoulder end may be cut off flat because it will be hidden behind the body.
11: right arm with hand, mirror of cell 10.
12: left LEG with foot, one piece, pointing down, hip end at the top of the cell, hip end may be cut off flat.
13: right leg with foot, mirror of cell 12.
14: left hand as a FIST, small, for grabbing.
15: right hand as a fist, mirror.
No copyrighted characters or recognizable existing mascots.
Character name (never render name): Momo. Friendly round BLUE shaggy monster: electric cobalt shaggy hair around top and sides, sky-blue pear-shaped face/body, large white oval eyes normally with dark indigo pupils (pupils are NOT drawn here), small mouth with two tiny white teeth, small sky-blue arms and feet, a tiny yellow tuft on the chest that is NOT a tie. Adorable bashful personality. Rounded, soft, funny and lovable. Cell 1 is the cobalt shaggy hair that surrounds the head, cell 2 a small cobalt tuft on top, cell 3 the yellow chest tuft.
